title: Handley Page Halifax LV836
squadron: 427 LION SQN RCAF/ROYAL CANADIAN AIR FORCE
memorial_details:
Large, triangular-shaped, unfinished stone with an inset, rectangular, brass commemorative plaque, located adjacent to the 5th hole of the Romanby golf course Also in the Romanby Golf Club clubhouse are a painting of Halifax LV836 and a photograph of the crew, both glazed and framed, commemorating the loss.

This memorial is also dedicated to all members of BOMBER COMMAND who gave their lives in the defence of freedom 1939 - 1945
inscription: Stone of Remembrance: THIS MEMORIAL IS DEDICATED TO THE CREW OF HALIFAX LV836 FROM 427 LION SQN RCAF/ WHICH CRASHED NEAR HERE IN THE EARLY MORNING OF 21 FEBRUARY 1944/ (names)/ THIS MEMORIAL IS ALSO DEDICATED TO ALL MEMBERS OF BOMBER COMMAND WHO GAVE/ THEIR LIVES IN THE DEFENCE OF FREEDOM 1939 - 1945/ PER ARDUA AD ASTRA Painting: IN MEMORY OF THE CREW OF HALIFAX III LV836 ZL-W OF NO 427/ (LION) SQUADRON ROYAL CANADIAN AIR FORCE WHOSE AIRCRAFT/ CRASHED ON ROMANBY GOLF COURSE IMMEDIATELY AFTER TAKE-/ OFF FROM RCAF LEEMING AT 00:02 HOURS ON 21ST FEBRUARY/ 1944 WITH THE LOSS OF ALL ON BOARD./ HALIFAX W WAS ON A MISSION TO STUTTGART AND ITS/ BOMB LOAD OF 834 INCENDIARIES EXPLODED ON IMPACT./ (names)
